sections.title: Why Parently
sections.description:
Daycare is full, teachers get sick. Need help?
 Parently is here to help you find other parents to share daycare together.

sections.title: Share unexpected daycare needs
sections.description: You never know when you need help. Parently is here to help you find other parents to share daycare together.

sections.title: How it works
sections.description:
Sign up and tell us about you and your child(ren).
What days do you need help? What days can you provide help? Find other parents at your school to share daycare together.
